customer.subject: Booking request received
customer.body:
Hello, {{contactName}}!

We received your booking request at {{tenantName}}.

Services: {{serviceNames}}

Date/Time: {{scheduledAt}}

Total: {{totalPrice}}

customer.body:
Hello, {{contactName}}!

Your booking has been confirmed.

Date: {{localDate}}

Time: {{localTime}}

Services: {{serviceNames}}

Total: {{totalPrice}}

We look forward to seeing you!

customer.body:
Hello, {{contactName}}!

Unfortunately we could not confirm your booking.

Reason: {{reason}}

Feel free to make a new booking on our website.

customer.subject: We need more information about your booking
customer.body:
Hello, {{contactName}}!

Our team needs more information before confirming your booking.

Information needed: {{informationNeeded}}

Click here to respond

admin.subject: Customer responded to the information request
admin.body:
Customer {{submittedByEmail}} responded to the information request.

Response: {{customerResponse}}

View booking in the dashboard

customer.body:

Your booking has been cancelled.

{{reasonLine}}

Services: {{serviceNames}}

customer.body:
Hello, {{contactName}}!

We recorded that you did not attend your {{serviceNames}} appointment on {{localDate}} at {{localTime}}.

If this is a mistake, reply to this email to reach {{tenantName}}.

Just a reminder that your booking is tomorrow.

Date: {{localDate}}

Time: {{localTime}}

Services: {{serviceNames}}

customer.body:
Hello, {{contactName}}!

Just a reminder that your booking is today.

Time: {{localTime}}

Services: {{serviceNames}}

We are looking forward to seeing you!

customer.subject: You earned loyalty points!
customer.body:
Hello, {{customerName}}!

Your service is complete and you earned {{totalPointsEarned}} points in loyalty rewards.

Your current balance is {{currentBalance}} points.

Use your points on your next booking!

customer.subject: Your points are about to expire
customer.body:
Hello, {{customerName}}!

You have {{pointsExpiringSoon}} points about to expire on {{earliestExpiresAt}}.

Make a booking to use your points before they expire.

staff.subject: Invitation to join Ikaro
staff.body:
Hello, {{staffName}}!

You have been invited to join the {{tenantName}} team on the Ikaro platform.

Click here to accept the invitation and access your account.

If you were not expecting this invitation, please ignore this email.

customer.subject: Your recurring schedule is confirmed
customer.body:

Your recurring schedule at {{tenantName}} is confirmed.

Service: {{serviceName}}

Days: {{weekdays}} at {{localTime}}

Period: {{startsOn}} to {{endsOn}}

Every appointment is already on the calendar.

customer.subject: Your recurring schedule request was not accepted
customer.body:
Hello, {{contactName}}!

Unfortunately we could not confirm your recurring schedule for {{serviceName}}. Nothing was booked.

Feel free to make a new request on our website.

customerExpired.subject: Your recurring schedule request expired
customerExpired.body:
Hello, {{contactName}}!

Your recurring schedule request for {{serviceName}} was not answered in time and has expired. Nothing was booked.

You can request it again on our website.

customer.subject: Your recurring schedule was ended
customer.body:
Hello, {{contactName}}!

customerEndedByStaff.body:

Your recurring schedule for {{serviceName}} was ended by {{tenantName}}.
